EXTENSION.JMCMODLIB.CONFIG.BetterSaveSlo: Configure the total number of save slots. Re-enter the profile flow, or restart if needed, after changing this.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.COPY_EMP: Slot {Id} has no progress.save, so it cannot be used as the copy source.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.COPY_OVE:
Copy slot {Source} into slot {Target}?
[color=#ff8f8f]The existing target save will be deleted and replaced.[/color]
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.IMPORT_N: Normal saves can only be imported after the game is running with MOD save isolation enabled.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.IMPORT_E: Normal slots 1-3 do not contain progress.save.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.IMPORT_P: Choose a normal-mode save to import into MOD slot {Target}.
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.IMPORT_O:
Import normal slot {Source} into MOD slot {Target}?
[color=#ff8f8f]The existing target save will be deleted and replaced.[/color]
EXTENSION.BETTERSAVESLOTS.POPUP.IMPORT_D: Imported normal slot {Source} into MOD slot {Target}.
